summary: This document extends the way Virtual Private LAN Service (VPLS) carries multicast traffic, which earlier RFCs 4761 and 4762 handled with unicast tunnels. Those tunnels can waste bandwidth when a lot of multicast data is sent. It describes solutions to overcome a subset of those limits.

eli5.summary: Imagine mailing the same newsletter to a whole class by sending one separate copy down every road. This document finds smarter ways to share one copy so the roads are not clogged.

questions: how does multicast work in vpls
